subject.title: fix(slack): time out stalled external file uploads

question: Should OpenClaw expose PlatformMessageNotDispatchedError as a public plugin SDK contract that lets channel adapters authorize queued-message replay?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but accepting a public adapter-owned assertion about recipient-visible dispatch establishes a compatibility-sensitive message-delivery contract that only maintainers can own long term.

options.title: Accept the narrow public marker
options.body: Keep the documented nominal marker, require adapter ownership of the final dispatch boundary, and land after refreshing exact-head proof.

options.title: Keep replay authority internal
options.body: Land the Slack timeout but remove the public SDK export and retain conservative non-replay behavior for external plugins.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow public marker
recommendation.body: Keep the documented nominal marker, require adapter ownership of the final dispatch boundary, and land after refreshing exact-head proof.
